public_docs.title: GuildConsole documentation
public_docs.intro: A practical guide to connecting a Discord server, managing access, installing plugins and operating GuildConsole safely.
public_docs.about_text: GuildConsole is a web control center for Discord server owners and administrators. It combines server configuration, member operations, security tools, automation, AI services and optional plugins in one interface.
public_docs.about_text_2: Each Discord server has an isolated workspace. Settings, subscriptions, plugin configuration and operational data belong only to that server, while the owner keeps centralized access from one account.
public_docs.step1_text: GuildConsole verifies your Discord identity and reads the servers where you have management rights.
public_docs.step2_text: Select an existing server card. If the bot is not connected, use Connect and approve the requested Discord permissions.
public_docs.step3_text: Check the bot status, synchronize the Discord structure and assign panel access to trusted administrators.
public_docs.step4_text: Install plugins, complete their settings and enable them. Disabled plugins keep their configuration without processing events.
public_docs.server_text: Connection state, subscription period, synchronization time and installed plugin status at a glance.
public_docs.members_text: Search members, inspect activity, review roles and manage supported member operations.
public_docs.security_text: Permission inspection, moderation workflows, security events, audit history and controlled restoration tools.
public_docs.automation_text: Scheduled workflows, event management, notifications and operational monitoring for recurring server tasks.
public_docs.ai_text: Configure AI providers and routes once, then use them in translation and moderation plugins with usage controls.
public_docs.languages_text: Choose the panel language and configure server languages used by multilingual Discord plugins.
public_docs.plugins_title: Add features without rebuilding your bot
public_docs.plugins_text: Plugins are independent modules with settings for each server. The store includes onboarding, verification, anti-flood protection, role menus, voting, activity rankings, audit alerts, backups, event planning, AI moderation and multilingual translation groups.
public_docs.lifecycle_text: Install creates the configuration, Enable starts processing, Disable pauses the module, and Uninstall removes its server configuration.
public_docs.access_text: Discord authentication and server roles determine which control centers and operations a user may open.
public_docs.billing_text: Pay directly for the selected server and period. Access does not renew automatically; a single advance expiry reminder is available.
public_docs.data_text: Server settings and plugin data are separated by Discord server. Sensitive platform operations remain restricted to authorized administrators.
public_docs.help_text: After signing in, open Feedback & issues to report a bug, attach screenshots or suggest a feature or custom plugin. Include the server, plugin, expected result and the steps that caused the problem.
